Name: SlidePushCorrectives
Description: Block dedicated to create Slide Push Correctives System

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Block dedicated to create Slide Push Correctives System. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the node/object name this block should use. Direction: enter names separated by commas (example format: nameA,nameB,nameC). Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need. Template parent examples: L_ArmSlideSlideDriver_Loc, L_LegSlideSlideDriver_Loc, Spine_End_Jnt.
